name: FANCD2 and FANCI associated nuclease 1
pathways: double-strand break repair via homologous recombination

function.text: FAN1 encodes fanconi-associated nuclease 1. Annotated molecular activities include 5'-3' exonuclease activity and 5'-flap endonuclease activity. It participates in DNA repair and double-strand break repair via homologous recombination.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to karyomegalic interstitial nephritis (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
